name: combly
description: Comment export and comment search for YouTube, TikTok and Instagram posts with Combly: export comments to CSV, find what viewers ask and pick fair giveaway winners.

interface.shortDescription: Comment export, comment search and giveaway winner picker
interface.longDescription: Comment export and comment search for YouTube videos, TikTok posts and Instagram posts: load a post's comments, search them by keyword, author, date, questions or links, and export comments to CSV. As a giveaway winner picker, draw random winners and backups under the host's rules, with a public winner page and proof code. Uses the plan limits of your Combly account.
interface.defaultPrompt: Load the comments on this YouTube video and tell me the five most common questions viewers ask.
